name: aggregator-desktop
description: 大模型聚合器桌面端（Electron + React + TypeScript）
author: 杭州灵界科技有限公司

scripts.build:engine: node scripts/python-release-policy.mjs sync && node scripts/python-release-policy.mjs build-engine && node scripts/write-engine-digest.mjs
scripts._build_pack: npm run build:engine && npm run prepare:electron-runtime && npm run prepare:licenses && node scripts/write-update-trust.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/release-output.mjs clean && electron-builder --publish never && node scripts/release-output.mjs prune && node scripts/_verify_pack.mjs
scripts._build_pack_early: npm run build:engine && npm run prepare:electron-runtime && npm run prepare:licenses && node scripts/write-update-trust.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/release-output.mjs clean && electron-builder --config electron-builder.early-access.yml --publish never && node scripts/release-output.mjs prune && node scripts/_verify_pack.mjs
scripts._build_pack_early_frozen: node scripts/write-engine-digest.mjs check && node scripts/write-update-trust.mjs check && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.early-access.yml --publish never && node scripts/release-output.mjs prune && node scripts/_verify_pack.mjs
scripts.package:lean: node scripts/prepare-pack.mjs lean && cross-env DMX_VARIANT=lean npm run _build_pack
scripts.package:full: node scripts/prepare-pack.mjs full && cross-env DMX_VARIANT=full npm run _build_pack
scripts.package:early:lean: node scripts/prepare-pack.mjs lean && cross-env DMX_VARIANT=lean NACHUAN_UPDATE_TIER=early-access npm run _build_pack_early
scripts.package:early:full: node scripts/prepare-pack.mjs full && cross-env DMX_VARIANT=full NACHUAN_UPDATE_TIER=early-access npm run _build_pack_early
scripts.evidence:generate: npm run prepare:node-runtime && node scripts/node-runtime-policy.mjs run scripts/release-evidence.mjs generate
scripts.evidence:verify: npm run verify:node-runtime && node scripts/node-runtime-policy.mjs run scripts/release-evidence.mjs verify
